morning.insight:
💡 목요일, ZAIC D-DAY + 금통위 + 반도체 모멘텀

**KOSPI, 하루 만에 반등 — 그러나 여전히 박스권**
어제 KOSPI가 3.29% 급등하며 5,700선을 회복했습니다. 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스가 각각 5.67%, 5.81% 오르며 반도체주가 상승을 주도했고, 2개월 만에 사이드카가 발동될 정도로 매수세가 강했습니다. 하지만 이는 10/20 5,552 저점 대비 기술적 반등에 가깝습니다. 7,000선 붕괴(9/14) 후 5주째 5,400~5,800 박스권 — 추세 반전을 말하기는 아직 이릅니다. 오늘 금통위 결과와 엔비디아 GTC 후폭풍이 방향을 가를 변수입니다.

**🔥 ZAIC 성과발표회 오늘!**
제2회 ZAIC 성과발표회가 오늘입니다. 2차 심사결과 보고(10/19 밀림)는 어제까지 완료되었어야 하나 콕핏 상태가 0/1(0%)로 남아 있습니다. 오전에 즉시 확인하고 행사 준비에 만전을 기하세요. New-Z 웰컴데이 강의(어제 예정)도 진행 여부를 체크해야 합니다.

**엔비디아 GTC Berlin 핵심: AI는 이제 '소프트웨어 트렌드'가 아닌 '제조업'**
젠슨 황의 키노트 화두는 'AI는 새로운 산업 혁명이자 제조업'이었습니다. Vera Rubin DSX Pod(컨테이너형 AI 팩토리)는 데이터센터 구축 시간을 '월→일' 단위로 단축하겠다는 선언입니다. 1GW 팩토리에 $50B vs 연수익 $40B — 이 계산이 맞다면 AI 인프라 투자는 지속 가능합니다. 제니엘 AX 추진에도 시사점: AI를 '비용'이 아닌 '인프라 투자'로 프레이밍하는 전략이 유효합니다.

**오늘 체크리스트**

- [ ] [Z-P1] 사업장별 근태현황 파악 준비 (내일 마감)
- [ ] 엔비디아 GTC Berlin 키노트 주요 내용 팀 공유 (AX TF 참고)
- [ ] 한은 금통위 결과 모니터링 (오늘 오전·오후 발표)

articles.body: 테슬라 3분기 매출 $28.05B, GAAP 영업이익 $718M(-56%). FSD 가입률 75%로 신기록을 세우며 장 마감 후 주가가 올랐다.

articles.headline: 젠슨 황, 유럽에 1년 $10B 투자…'AI 인프라=제조업' 프레임
articles.eng: Huang pledges $10B a year to Europe, framing AI infrastructure as manufacturing
articles.body: 엔비디아가 GTC 베를린에서 유럽에 연 $10B 투자를 밝혔다. 1GW AI 팩토리 $50B vs 연수익 $40B 계산을 제시하며 AI 인프라 투자의 지속가능성을 강조했다.

articles.headline: 스페이스X·테슬라 합병 검토…최대 $3.5조 초대형 딜

articles.body: 스페이스X와 테슬라 이사회가 최대 $3.5조 규모의 합병을 검토 중이라는 보도가 나왔다.

articles.headline: Tesla Shares Rise After Hours as Free Cash Flow Turns Positive
articles.body: The EV maker posted positive free cash flow and flat revenue, sending shares higher after hours even as net income fell.

articles.headline: SpaceX and Tesla Boards Weigh a $3.5 Trillion Combination
articles.body: Boards of SpaceX and Tesla are studying a potential merger that would create one of the world's largest companies.

articles.headline: Anthropic S-1 Shows Red-Hot Growth and Massive Computing Costs
articles.body: Anthropic's IPO filing reveals rapid revenue growth alongside soaring computing costs and risk disclosures.

articles.headline: AI Boom-or-Bust Scenarios Loom Large at World Financial Summit
articles.body: Finance leaders debate whether the AI investment boom can be sustained as debt-funded buildout draws scrutiny.

articles.headline: Canada to Provide Steel and Auto Sectors With Billions to Ease Trade Crunch
articles.body: Ottawa announced multibillion-dollar support for steel and auto producers squeezed by the trade war with the U.S.

articles.headline: Indonesia Stocks Log Worst Day Since 1998 on MSCI Downgrade Warning
articles.body: Indonesian equities plunged after MSCI warned it may reclassify the market to standalone status.

articles.headline: Tesla Spending Continues to Lag Musk's $25 Billion Target
articles.body: Tesla's capex remains well short of Elon Musk's stated target even as the company touts record FSD attach rates.

articles.body: The boards are weighing a merger that would combine SpaceX's satellite and launch business with Tesla's automotive and AI ambitions.

articles.headline: Meta Offers Zuckerberg New Shares to Shield Him From Wealth Tax
articles.body: Meta is proposing a new share grant for Mark Zuckerberg as California weighs a billionaire wealth tax.

articles.headline: IBM Posts 5% Sales Growth, Says Infrastructure Deals Came Back
articles.body: IBM reported 5% revenue growth as enterprise infrastructure spending rebounded despite the AI-rout uncertainty.

articles.headline: Electronic Arts to Shed 400 Jobs, Shut Down BioWare
articles.body: EA said it will cut about 400 jobs and shut down its BioWare studio as part of cost reductions.

articles.headline: BlackRock's Fink Sees Inflation Risk in Slow Data-Center Buildout
articles.body: Larry Fink warned that a slower-than-expected data-center buildout could stoke inflation and stall the AI economy.

articles.headline: Across Farm Country, Economic Discontent
articles.body: Economic frustration in rural America is reshaping the midterm map as farmers grapple with trade policy and high costs.

articles.headline: Taunting Trump Over Gas Prices, Iran Braces for Aftermath of U.S. Vote
articles.body: Iranian officials are taunting President Trump over fuel prices while bracing for the fallout of next month's U.S. midterms.

articles.headline: Tesla's Profit Slides Even as Its A.I. Ambitions Grow
articles.body: Tesla reported flat revenue and a steep drop in operating profit as heavy spending on A.I. and robotics weighs on margins.

articles.headline: Tech Stocks Lead Wall Street's Rebound From the A.I. Selloff
articles.body: Stocks steadied as investors looked past the A.I. rout, with technology shares leading a broad rebound.

articles.body: A health-technology start-up says its A.I. model can flag disease risk early, drawing both excitement and skepticism.

articles.body: Democrats are competing in once-safe Republican districts as the party builds an edge on top issues heading into the midterms.

articles.headline: Trump super PAC pumps $277 million into midterms
articles.body: President Trump's flagship super PAC, MAGA Inc., has poured $277 million into the midterms as Republicans scramble to hold their majority.

articles.headline: Alberta votes to stay in Canada amid trade war with U.S.
articles.body: Alberta rejected a push toward leaving Canada, a win for Canadian unity amid a trade war with the U.S. and tensions with Trump.

articles.headline: Vance declines to endorse Netanyahu for reelection as Israeli leader

articles.body: Kyiv said Washington has resumed intelligence sharing as Trump envoy Steve Witkoff heads to Russia for talks.

articles.headline: U.S. gets its first new national park in six years
articles.body: The designation marks the first new national park in six years, expanding protected lands in the American West.

articles.body: Steve Witkoff discussed the resumption of peace dialogue with the Russian president, followed by a US-China-Russia meeting next month.

articles.body: The French president expressed anger after US and other rightwing leaders blamed migrants for violence and looting.

articles.headline: NSA warns on 'critical' cyber vulnerabilities detected using AI
articles.body: Researchers used OpenAI and Google models to find severe faults in software used on a majority of websites around the world.

articles.headline: Netflix's $300bn problem: lack of hits piles pressure on streaming giant
articles.body: A scarcity of breakout hits is piling pressure on Netflix as subscriber growth cools and competition intensifies.
